## Why visit

A useful beer-led alternative to the ornate station-area pubs, especially when you want to compare several cask styles or add something from a bottle. The three-floor building also gives it a separate food angle through its Tibetan concession upstairs. Despite the name, CAMRA describes independent operation with freedom to stock a broad range, so do not assume it is restricted to one brewery. It fits naturally between a visit to the Vines and the short city-centre walk towards Renshaw Street and Roscoe Street.

## Beer

CAMRA describes a light-to-dark cask range, craft taps and bottled beer.
